title: nazm.fix/1
description: One edit considered by `nazm fix --json`, resolved to a real file and offset. Output is one object per line on stdout.

code.description: The diagnostic this edit came from.

file.description: The file to write, as it was named when loaded. A merged multi-file program reports the file a reader would open.

start.description: Byte offset within that file, not within the merged buffer.

applied.description: Whether this run wrote it. Always false without `--apply`.

skipped.description: Why it was not applied. `null` when it was applied, or when it would be.
